description: Use for a concise feed of the most recent stored Macedonian business and international news. Results are saved snapshots, not a live feed, and retain attribution, FinPortal links, and original source links when available. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `source` and the original source URL in `originalUrl`; `publisher` identifies FinPortal.mk. If `url` is null, say no matching FinPortal page is published and use `originalUrl` for verification; do not invent a route or search for other coverage unless the user asks.
name: get_latest_news
title: Најнови вести
